_comment: exp/nextgen-fin edge case: FULL +-45 SKINS (twill_3k_198 @ 45 both faces) over a UD spanwise core. The +-45 shell carries torsion, the UD core carries bending, so flex is set almost entirely by the core ply count. NO BIAX -- +-45 from the 3k twill rotated 45 deg. Symmetric TaperDesign. QUARTER pad keeps the heel stiff; MID pad (0 or 1 UD pair) seats the kick.
_targets: flex W(90) ~13.5 N (baseline 15.52 - 2), kick MID f~0.46, k_twist > 16249 N.mm/rad at a matched theta_at_probe (baseline 118.3 deg). Expect k_twist well above the floor given full +-45 skins.
